scope: One fresh frozen Task06 coding/UI fixture under the installed private guarded 64K owner package; staged model-owned edits with independent evaluator feedback
implementation: The model changed only web/app.js. The first bounded Build completed and compacted, then independent checks exposed a nonfunctional visible Filter. One repair assumed unsupported server-side query filtering. After two failed attempts, the evaluator supplied the actual API contract; a smaller client-side repair passed. Separate source/browser probes then caught Save and Import violating the active filter; the saved Agent repaired each. The last model source SHA256 was b25529f713ddc962fed2ea2434f6c3719f07077e23d8051e5f2a23adbb9d5ce7.

independent_acceptance.frozen_grade: PASS after evaluator review; the result is assisted and does not establish unassisted first-attempt quality
independent_acceptance.automatic: 2/2, unchanged original test and seed data
independent_acceptance.browser: 7/7 independent checks: stored HTML literal text, labelled invalid input, real first-save 503 with one manual retry and exactly one row, save/reload at 390x844 and 1280x800, visible Filter/Import, seed preservation, console/network inspection
independent_acceptance.filter_save: Independent alpha-filter/beta-save probe PASS: beta row stays hidden
independent_acceptance.filter_import: Independent alpha-filter/beta-import probe PASS: beta row stays hidden; pre-repair failure retained
independent_acceptance.source_review: Independent evaluator inspected the final model diff and exact production handler; no remaining Task06 blocker found
independent_acceptance.app_restart: Evaluator server stopped and restarted against the same disposable DB; 34 persisted rows were served after restart, including 25 browser-check rows
independent_acceptance.native: Five model-owned Build stages and two read-only Ask handoffs each completed with one native compaction

checker_fix: The opt-in visible Filter check initially prescribed one exact empty-state sentence. PR #56 changed it to observe the filtered row disappear, require nonempty visible feedback, and reject remaining row IDs; the revised checker still rejected a known auto-import fixture and passed the final page. Frozen default scoring was unchanged.

semantic_handoff.neutral_restart: Ask read TASK.md and current source, but called a syntax check independently verified after its read-only shell attempt was denied. It correctly treated browser acceptance as unverified because external reports were not yet accessible in the project.
semantic_handoff.artifact_retrieval: The evaluator copied the actual browser report, traces/screenshots, two filter probes and source review into project artifacts/evaluator. A second saved-session Ask read them and correctly attributed the browser 7/7 result to the evaluator.
semantic_handoff.remaining_false_or_lost_state: The next stored checkpoint still collapsed the objective to the last Import repair, omitted the earlier failed-check lineage and staged assistance, and named a browser report path that does not exist. The first handoff also invented a pytest requirement even though the original unittest checks passed. External artifact retrieval improved the answer but did not make the checkpoint semantically complete.

resources: Seven guarded native stages totaled 676.059 seconds of prompt-active time. Every stage sampled normal pressure level 1 with zero swap growth; no memory abort. This is not a 45–60 minute green active-work qualification.
next_blocker: Keep the assisted artifact pass separate from the failed handoff. Make current task/evaluator evidence durable and discoverable after compaction/restart without adding another prompt rule, then repeat a fresh held-out task. Continue clean install and green active endurance before proposing any public release.
